subject: general
question: A conical tent with base diameter 10 m and height 12 m has been made. An additional 10% cloth is required as wastage in stitching the tent. Find the area of the cloth required (in m²). [Use π = 3.14]
solution:
Given:

A conical tent with a base diameter of 10 m and a height of 12 m has been made. 

An additional 10% cloth is required as wastage in stitching the tent.

Concept used:

Curved surface area = πrl

where r = radius of the base and l = slant height

Slant height, L = sqrt{R² + H²}

where R = radius of the base, H = Height

The area of the cloth needed to make the conical tent is equal to the curved surface area of the conical tent.

Calculation:

Radius of the base = 10/2 = 5m

Slant height of the tent

⇒ sqrt {12² + 5²}

⇒ 13m

Total curved surface area of the conical tent

⇒ π × 5 × 13

⇒ 65π m2

Now, the area of the cloth required

⇒ 65π + 65π × 10%

⇒ 65π + 6.5π

⇒ 71.5π m²

**∴ The area of the cloth required is 71.5π m2.**
